notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.2.1 released!
notes.content:
Greetings defenders of the galaxy!

After countless weeks of blood, sweat and tears we are proud to announce the update 1.2.1 of AIRA VR!

Once again, we have noticeably increased the performance under the hood and visibly polished up the graphics. We have also added many comfort functions such as snap rotation, the possibility to skip sequences and smooth teleport. All in all, we have brought AIRA VR technically up to date and thus paved the way for numerous other options...

Finally, we filled up the engine oil in the Command Ship and replaced the spark plugs. Oh boy, it runs like a charm!

We wish you continue to have lots of fun on your interstellar journeys and please feel free to let us know, if you encounter any kind of issue.

your Racoons

notes.title: Oasis Update out now
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/7c157fe9bdc297e9749989aa59d639362d100590.png[/img]

Here it is: The update 1.1.0 of AIRA VR! 

[b]New Content[/b]

The new "Oasis" map is now available and playable in a [b]new freeplay mode[/b].
Defend against 7 attack-waves with your favorite towers and weapons, available from the beginning. Master the Oasis map to recieve a new achievement and to permanently unlock the [b]new Gauss Tower[/b]. This new Tower has physical projectiles and is especially effective against the [i]Skilith Ray Deflect[/i], which is immune to the laser weapons. 

[b]Visual Improvements[/b]

We have polished and reworked many things, from all towers to some weapons. Mostly all levels providing a substantive upgrade in both mood and ambience. In the future we want to improve these aspects even further.

[b]SteamVR Input[/b]

From now on we're supporting the latest SteamVR input system, which allows us to use the full potential and support all SteamVR HMDs including the new Valve Index. Now you can customize your controlls for all compatible devices. In the "SteamVR Settings" - "[url=http://127.0.0.1:8998/dashboard/controllerbinding.html]Controller Binding[/url]" you can select "AIRA VR" to adjust it. Furthermore, the inputs feel more precise, all buttons and feedback systems can be used.

[b]Performance and Bugs[/b]

We were able to increase the performance at Level 7 and fixed some minor bugs.


We hope you enjoy our Oasis Update and please let us know, if you encounter any kind of issue.
Cheers,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/66e0025363bac731a90624c6a194a908b81c6dbb.png[/img]

notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.0.5 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

here is the next update for you. We have made some improvements regarding our sniper rifle for better handling. From now there is no cooldown anymore to reload. Instead the rifle now has a charge dealing more damage depending on the time passed between shots. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/dd58ede69c46d0448f92f0677b1aeb9191e8dba1.jpg[/img]

Furthermore we made some balancing tweaks and added a new tutorial wave to level 1. Also there have been some quality of live improvements. The labels in the shop got a rework to be more readable and easier to understand. 
Also from now individual or all cutscenes can be turned off to progress faster in the game.

 We hope you continue to have fun in defending the galaxy!

notes.title: Free Demo and Version 1.0.4 out now!
notes.content:
Greetings space captains!

With our upcomming update we have some news for you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/aba52a09a1815c8dfe395d0b31ab387b3b5ac495.jpg[/img]

First, in order to boulster our ranks we created a combat training simulation for our new recruits. In the Demo version you are tasked with the quest to repell 2 attack-waves on the ice dessert Skadica.
[b]From now on, the free Demo is available for download.[/b]

For our seasoned captains a few optimization and tweaks are available in the full version. Most cut-scenes have recieved a graphical upgrade, furthermore the balancing in late levels has been modyfied to provide a better challenge.

We wish you continue to have lots of fun defending the galaxy!

notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.0.3 released!
notes.content:
Windows Mixed Reality is fully supported now!

This means you can [b]enjoy AIRA VR with your Oculus, Vive or a WMR[/b] headset. Furthermore we improved the balancing, especially in the survival modes and fixed some minor issues. We also slightly reworked some cutscenes and AIRA will talk a little less from now on.

The weapons are fully reloaded and your command ship is ready for the next mission!

notes.title: Craming is over, time for fun! Take advantage of the AIRA VR limited offer now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/16fbbe50799db640af520bace96946baac1f4eee.jpg[/img]

As graduates we know it all too well... The past few weeks meant a lot of blood, sweat and tears for our students. To sweeten your upcoming free time, we slashed the price of AIRA VR during this year’s Spring Break! There’s no need to worry – our friends from all around the world can of course enjoy it too. ;-)

Now it’s time to put down the books and turn your VR headset on!

notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.0.2 released!
notes.content:
"Bonjour" to our french speaking folks!

The next update of AIRA VR is focused on language. From now on it is possible to switch the interface language to french as well.

We keep it rolling and wish you continue to have lots of fun defending the galaxy!

notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.0.1 released!
notes.content:
Here it is: The first update of AIRA VR! This time we focused on fixing some minor issues and improved a bunch of small details.

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*]The button to skip the intro sequence is now available from the start. This way you are able to defend the galaxy more quickly.
[*]As desired in some reviews, we slightly increased the difficulty in level 1 and 2.
[/list]

Finally, we called the pest control to eradicate some bugs, did some vacuum cleaning to liberate the command ship of star dust and fed the aliens.

We wish you continue to have lots of fun on your interstellar journeys!
